LOCK all costume parts: short-sleeved WHITE blouse, PALE BUTTER-YELLOW V-neck sleeveless vest with tan V trim, BRIGHT PINK neck bow with TWO LONG TAILS, modest PINK PLEATED SKIRT, WHITE SOCKS each with ONE narrow pink band, rounded DARK NAVY SHOES. Low defensive crouch facing SCREEN-RIGHT: both knees deeply bent, body lowered, one hand shielding the upper body and the other held ahead; both navy shoes planted and completely visible. Giant anime eyes face the opponent. Keep modest skirt hanging over bent thighs; no underwear view, no extra limbs, no ground plane.
One separate full-body polished 2D cel-shaded sprite facing SCREEN-RIGHT. Adapt the whole-body pose, never merely rotate or warp the reference. Keep the character entirely within comfortable transparent margins: full eye tops, hands/fingers and both shoes must be visible. True transparent RGBA background with clean cutout edge; all pixels outside figure zero alpha. No glow, halo, gradient backdrop, ground, cast shadow, text, watermark, second character, speed trails, motion blur or extra limbs. Match the approved model and official costume; original fan-game pose, not a photograph or chibi plush.

observations: Accroupissement bas, deux appuis et mains en défense ; jupe couvrante, yeux anime conservés, aucune partie coupée.
